antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 810nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in microglia if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Multi-wavelength cascade: 447 THz (670nm) prep + 370 THz (810nm) main + 306 THz (980nm) recovery targeting cytochrome_c_oxidase in microglia.
